Anya Kowalski  
Tel Aviv, Israel | +972-54-123-4567 | anya.kowalski@email.com | linkedin.com/in/anya-kowalski | portfolio.anyakowalski.com  

Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, University of Warsaw, 2021  
Graduated with a focus on distributed systems and cloud-native development, leveraging academic research to inform real-world engineering challenges. Early exposure to collaborative problem-solving in university projects laid the groundwork for my technical approach to SaaS development.  

Professional Experience  
As a Junior Software Developer at Startup Catalyst (2021), I contributed to the backend architecture of a scalable SaaS platform, primarily using Python to handle API integrations and data processing pipelines. This role required close collaboration with product managers and designers to translate business requirements into technical specifications, emphasizing the importance of clear communication in cross-functional teams. Transitioning to NexGen SaaS Solutions in 2022, I expanded my expertise as a Full-Stack Developer, building web applications with Node.js and React while optimizing MongoDB queries to reduce latency by 30% in high-traffic scenarios. My work on REST API design became a cornerstone of the product’s architecture, enabling seamless integration with third-party services. In 2023, I took on a Lead Developer (Contract) role at CloudForge Innovations, where I architected microservices using gRPC, implemented CI/CD pipelines to accelerate deployment cycles, and mentored junior engineers in best practices for scalable system design.  

Technical Skills  
GitLab CI: Integrated into the development workflow to automate testing and deployment for multiple projects.  
Kubernetes: Briefly utilized in container orchestration during a microservices migration, focusing on resource allocation and service discovery.  
AWS: Leveraged EC2 instances and S3 storage to host a prototype SaaS application, optimizing costs through auto-scaling configurations.  
CI/CD pipelines: Designed and maintained pipelines using GitLab CI/CD, reducing deployment time by 40% for a flagship product.  
Docker: Containerized backend services to ensure consistency across development and production environments.  
JavaScript: Developed interactive components for a React-based dashboard, enhancing user engagement through dynamic data visualization.  
MongoDB: Optimized query performance for a real-time analytics tool, improving data retrieval speed by 25%.  
Node.js: Built server-side logic for a customer management system, handling concurrent requests efficiently.  
Python: Implemented data processing scripts to automate report generation for internal stakeholders.  
REST API design: Created endpoints for a payment gateway integration, ensuring compliance with security and scalability standards.  
React: Developed a responsive admin panel with reusable components, streamlining maintenance efforts.  
TypeScript: Refactored legacy codebases to improve type safety and reduce runtime errors in a collaborative project.  

Summary  
My career trajectory has been defined by a commitment to building scalable, user-centric solutions in the SaaS space. From backend development to full-stack leadership, I’ve consistently delivered results by aligning technical decisions with business goals. My work at NexGen and CloudForge has honed my ability to balance innovation with operational efficiency, while academic rigor has provided a foundation for tackling complex problems.  

Projects  
1. **SaaS Platform Optimization**: Redesigned MongoDB queries and introduced caching mechanisms, reducing average response times by 30% for a customer analytics tool.  
2. **Microservices Architecture**: Spearheaded the migration of a monolithic application to a microservices model using gRPC, improving system resilience and deployment flexibility.  
3. **CI/CD Pipeline Automation**: Streamlined deployment workflows with GitLab CI/CD, achieving 95% automation for critical releases and minimizing manual intervention.  
4. **React Admin Dashboard**: Built a modular admin interface with React and TypeScript, incorporating real-time data updates and customizable reporting features.  

Languages  
English (fluent), Polish (native), Hebrew (basic)
